GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Pushed fwd & raced keenly 5th 3 Wide With Cover (3L from lead) early . Held Ground midrace & held together Five Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 200m & sprinted with winner @ 150m. Shaded late. # Wide/solid
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping bumped. Rdr std instructed to settle midfield and to conserve the mare’s finishing effort by not placing it under pressure too soon in the home straight. She said able to improve and place her mnt into clear running straightening and bearing in mind her instructions, used only limited vigour from the 300m until near the 200m, at which point she placed mnt under full pressure however began to lay in and proved difficult to ride out. Tnr confirmed instructions and said as the mare was four weeks between runs, she was concerned could not sustain long finishing effort.
